notes.title: And We Bring You.. Some Extra Achievements!
notes.content:
Our first update to Cipheur have landed:

- Added the Nightmare mode and made some changes to the Hard (since people complained some quotes were too short with the previous Hard)
- Also added a tutorial text to explain you can actually close the congratulations popup to make a screenshot if you so wish.
- Finally, introduced achievements for the completion of the free packs (no, we don't plan to add achievements for the paid packs)


Also
- Fixed the double quote in the Videogame Quotes.
- Fixed the Korean language description.

notes.title: Tangram Collection Update
notes.content:
🧩Tangram Collection was updated!🧩

We know it's somewhat overdue, but the long-promised update for Tangram Collection finally landed with a number of key changes:

🧩 All the shapes and puzzle pieces were redrawn from scratch to ensure they fit properly.
🧩 The interface issues (like rotate button not working correctly) were fixed.
🧩 The game now has proper settings allowing.
🧩 Japanese language support was added.
🧩 Achievements were added.

And it's still completely free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182240/Tangram_Collection/
